Give IUPAC names of the following compounds:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{Cl})-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(ii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{O}-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3\)
(iii) a benzene ring carrying \(-\text{OH}\) at position 1 and \(-\text{CH}_3\) groups at both positions 2 and 6
(iv) a cyclohexane ring carrying \(-\text{NO}_2\) at one carbon and \(-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\) at the adjacent carbon

Give the structures and IUPAC names of the products expected from the following reactions:
(a) Catalytic reduction of butanal.
(b) Hydration of propene in the presence of dilute sulphuric acid.
(c) Reaction of propanone with methylmagnesium bromide followed by hydrolysis.

Arrange the following sets of compounds in order of their increasing boiling points:
(a) Pentan-1-ol, butan-1-ol, butan-2-ol, ethanol, propan-1-ol, methanol.
(b) Pentan-1-ol, n-butane, pentanal, ethoxyethane.
solution:
(a) Methanol, ethanol, propan-1-ol, butan-2-ol, butan-1-ol, pentan-1-ol.
(b) n-Butane, ethoxyethane, pentanal and pentan-1-ol.

Show how are the following alcohols prepared by the reaction of a suitable Grignard reagent on methanal?
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(ii) cyclohexyl\(-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\) (a cyclohexane ring bearing a \(-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\) group)

Write structures of the products of the following reactions:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}=\text{CH}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{H}_2\text{O}/\text{H}^+}\)
(ii) methyl 2-(2-oxocyclohexyl)acetate, i.e. a cyclohexanone ring bearing a \(-\text{CH}_2-\text{C}(=\text{O})-\text{OCH}_3\) group on the carbon adjacent to the ring carbonyl, treated with \(\text{NaBH}_4\)
(iii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CHO} \xrightarrow{\text{NaBH}_4}\)
Arrange the following compounds in increasing order of their acid strength: Propan-1-ol, 2,4,6-trinitrophenol, 3-nitrophenol, 3,5-dinitrophenol, phenol, 4-methylphenol.

Write the structures of the major products expected from the following reactions:
(a) Mononitration of 3-methylphenol
(b) Dinitration of 3-methylphenol
(c) Mononitration of phenyl methanoate.
solution:
The combined influence of \(-\text{OH}\) and \(-\text{CH}_3\) groups determine the position of the incoming group.
(a) Two products: 3-methyl-4-nitrophenol (\(-\text{OH}\) at C-1, \(-\text{CH}_3\) at C-3, \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-4) and 5-methyl-2-nitrophenol (\(-\text{OH}\) at C-1, \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-2, \(-\text{CH}_3\) at C-5).
(b) 5-Methyl-2,4-dinitrophenol, i.e. the ring carries \(-\text{OH}\), a \(-\text{CH}_3\) group and two \(-\text{NO}_2\) groups, one ortho and one para to the \(-\text{OH}\).
(c) The para-nitrated ester: a benzene ring bearing \(-\text{OCOCH}_3\) at C-1 and \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-4.
_note: Book-internal inconsistency: part (c) asks for mononitration of phenyl METHANOATE (\(\text{HCOOC}_6\text{H}_5\)), but the structure drawn in the printed solution carries \(-\text{OCOCH}_3\), which is phenyl ETHANOATE (phenyl acetate). The solution is transcribed as drawn.

stem:
The following is not an appropriate reaction for the preparation of t-butyl ethyl ether:
\(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{ONa} + (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{Cl} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\)
(i) What would be the major product of this reaction?
(ii) Write a suitable reaction for the preparation of t-butylethyl ether.
solution:
(i) The major product of the given reaction is 2-methylprop-1-ene. It is because sodium ethoxide is a strong nucleophile as well as a strong base. Thus elimination reaction predominates over substitution.
(ii) \((\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{ONa} + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{Cl} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\)
